candidates.candidateStatement: Direct siblings controlled by UIListLayout or UIGridLayout must not rely on manual values for properties owned by that layout; use a nested wrapper or remove layout ownership for independent transforms.
externalClaimsNeeded: Verify UIListLayout and UIGridLayout ownership of sibling Position, Rotation, and Size.
runtimeTestsNeeded: Mutate owned properties on direct siblings and compare with a nested descendant wrapper.
ambiguities: UIListLayout size ownership changes under flex, AutomaticSize, and constraints; UIGridLayout constraints can override CellSize.

candidates.candidateStatement: Localized text that can outgrow its bounds should be exercised with locale elongation and given an explicit expansion, wrapping, or truncation policy; TextScaled and AutomaticSize should not be combined by default on one TextLabel.
externalClaimsNeeded: Verify Roblox Locale/Elongate guidance, AutomaticSize/TextScaled interaction, and fixed-label overflow behavior.
runtimeTestsNeeded: Exercise target locales, elongation, wrapping height, truncation, TextFits, and TextBounds.
ambiguities: Synthetic elongation does not validate shaping or every real locale; intentional truncation can be valid.

candidates.candidateStatement: Effective ClipsDescendants creates a rectangular descendant-rendering boundary that ZIndex cannot escape and UICorner does not round; rotation behavior must account for the current rollout state.
externalClaimsNeeded: Verify ClipsDescendants, ZIndex, UICorner, and rotated-descendant behavior.
runtimeTestsNeeded: Render high-Z overflow, rounded parents, rotated descendants, and rotated clipping ancestors.
ambiguities: Rotated descendant clipping and rotated parent clipping are different; rollout state may vary.

candidates.candidateStatement: Supersedable stateful tweens should have deterministic ownership, terminal values, and callbacks; same-property automatic cancellation means explicit Cancel is conditional rather than universal.
externalClaimsNeeded: Verify same-property replacement, different-property coexistence, Completed cancellation state, Cancel, and Pause semantics.
runtimeTestsNeeded: Rapidly replace, cancel, pause, and replay transitions while asserting winning state and callback count.
ambiguities: Roblox does not prescribe an ownership abstraction; decorative fire-and-forget tweens may not need one.
